elements.name: Green Roof
elements.carried: Sedum trays on a root barrier and drainage mat, with first-year watering.

options.name: Green Roof
options.note: Sedum trays in a 1-foot gravel edge over the EPDM roof. Roof framing is sized for saturated trays.

options.name: EPDM Only
options.note: The same 2,430 SF EPDM roof, exposed. No trays, gravel edge or tray crane day. The model shows it.

elements.name: Box Structure
elements.carried: Steel beams and posts carry the box and the 52-foot glass wall.

options.name: Steel, As Designed
options.note: Steel beams and posts, with the crane day to set them.

options.name: LVL and PSL
options.note: Engineered lumber beams, posts and connectors in place of the steel. Subject to the structural engineer.

elements.name: Siding and Soffits
elements.carried: Material at $14.00 per SF, plus 10 percent waste.
elements.label: Material Price per SF
elements.after: Installation and the rain screen stay as priced.

elements.name: Window Wall
elements.carried: Unilux Design Line, triple glazed, 1,429 SF with freight and duty.

options.name: Unilux Design Line
options.note: Triple-glazed windows, lift-slides and swing doors from Germany, with freight, duty and port handling.

options.name: North American
options.note: Aluminum-clad windows and lift-slides in the same openings, with freight.

elements.name: Porch Screens
elements.carried: Centor retractable screens that roll away into the frame.

options.name: Centor Retractable
options.note: Manual retractable screens across each porch opening.

options.name: Removable Panels
options.note: Screen panels in site-built frames that lift out.

elements.name: White Oak Flooring
elements.carried: 5 to 7 inch white oak, site finished, material at $15.00 per SF.
elements.label: Material Price per SF
elements.after: Installation and site finishing stay as priced.

elements.name: Floating Stair
elements.carried: White oak treads on a steel center stringer, with a frameless glass guard.

options.name: Floating Stair
options.note: Steel center stringer, white oak treads, stained and sealed on site.

options.name: Open Riser
options.note: Wood treads on steel plate stringers, open between the treads.

elements.name: Kitchen Cabinets
elements.where: Kitchen, 22 LF of Lowers and Uppers
elements.carried: Lower and upper cabinets at $750.00 per LF, furnished and installed.
elements.label: Cabinet Price per LF
elements.after: The island and the vanities are priced on their own.

elements.name: Appliances
elements.carried: Refrigerator, dishwasher, induction range, hood, microwave, washer and dryer.
elements.label: Appliance Allowance
elements.after: The allowance covers the appliances themselves.

elements.name: Bath Tile
elements.where: Bath Floors and Shower Walls, 485 SF
elements.carried: Tile material at $50.00 per SF, all in.
elements.label: Material Price per SF
elements.after: Setting and waterproofing stay as priced.

elements.name: Recessed Lights
elements.carried: Trimless recessed lights set in the drywall.

options.name: Trimless
options.note: 4 inch LED lights taped in flush with the ceiling.

options.name: Trimmed
options.note: The same lights with a visible trim ring.

elements.name: Floor Heat
elements.carried: Electric radiant mats under the bath tile. Heat pumps heat the house.

options.name: Bath Floors
options.note: Electric radiant mats with thermostats under the bath floor tile.

options.name: Warmboard-S
options.note: Hydronic radiant panels in place of the subfloor, with a combination boiler and water heater.

options.name: Thin Slab
options.note: Hydronic radiant in a 1-1/2 inch gypsum slab over the subfloor, with a combination boiler and water heater.

elements.name: Driveway Surface
elements.where: About 650 Feet to Old Albany Post Road
elements.carried: Item 4 stone over a 10-inch recycled concrete base, with stone water bars.

options.name: Stone
options.note: Item 4 stone wearing course over the full driveway.

options.name: Millings
options.note: 3 inches of recycled asphalt millings in place of the stone wearing course.

options.name: Tar and Chip
options.note: Two coats of liquid asphalt with stone chips rolled in, over the stone wearing course.

options.name: Grid Pavers
options.note: Stone-filled grid pavers on the steep section only, about 435 feet at 14 percent.

options.name: Concrete
options.note: 6-inch concrete with a broom finish on the steep section only, about 435 feet at 14 percent.

options.name: Asphalt
options.note: Two-course asphalt paving over the full driveway.

elements.name: Standby Generator
elements.carried: Not included. The house runs on the utility service.

options.name: Not Included
options.note: No backup power. The budget carries the 200 amp utility service.

options.name: 24 kW Propane
options.note: 24 kW generator on a 500 gallon buried propane tank, with the trenching, gas piping and first fill. The transfer switch carries the whole house.
